prompt: Discover and package one reusable Skill for RDKit RECAP terminal molecular fragments using RecapDecompose and GetLeaves. Ground the usage, input/output scope, terminal versus full hierarchy interpretation and valid empty results in the provided source. This is molecular fragmentation, not descriptor calculation. Choose appropriate delivery files and document prerequisites and invalid input boundaries. Do not install software or run source/business code on the host; business execution is permitted only in a Docker container. Do not claim chemical or scientific validation beyond the documented algorithm.
notes: Acceptance configuration for this copy. model.backend stays codex_cli: discovery, authoring and independent review keep the Codex CLI transport and are NOT migrated. runtime.<candidate>.options.backend=deepseek_api switches only the structured model_call stages - entry association, runtime planning and contract diagnosis - to the DeepSeek chat completions API. api_model is null on purpose: the DeepSeek model identifier is read from DEEPSEEK_MODEL / .env and is never guessed here, and the Codex model name above is never sent to the API provider. api_retries=0 and api_stream=true keep exactly one request per admitted call; the single request is bounded by model_timeout=600 and the stage by total_seconds=1800. reasoning_effort=medium is requested; DeepSeek maps it to high, which is recorded in the receipt as a compatibility mapping rather than an equivalence. service_tier has no DeepSeek equivalent: it is recorded and never sent.
